title: A Fast Implied Volatility Method with Expansions
abstract: arXiv:2606.10245v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present a regime-split Black--Scholes implied volatility solver in which every initial seed is a fully closed-form analytical expression, derived from the asymptotic structure of the Black--Scholes price in its natural domain. At the money, series reversion of an exact Gaussian identity yields a fourth-order seed with error $\mathcal{O}(s^8)$. In the moderate out-of-the-money region, successive Gaussian CDF approximations of increasing order produce explicit initial seed formulas whose accuracy is proved numerically, with no iteration or numerical inversion at the seed stage. In the deep out-of-the-money region, a Gaussian tail cancellation identity -- the Mills ratio -- reveals the asymptotic structure of the Black--Scholes price and motivates a ratio-corrected seed that achieves near-machine-precision initialisation for large moneyness. translated_title: 一种基于展开式的快速隐含波动率求解方法
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种分区求解的 Black–Scholes 隐含波动率求解器，其中每个初始种子都是完全闭式的解析表达式，这些表达式源自 Black–Scholes 价格在其自然定义域中的渐近结构。在平值区域，对一个精确高斯恒等式进行级数反演，得到误差为 $\mathcal{O}(s^8)$ 的四阶种子。在适度虚值区域，逐次提高阶数的高斯累积分布函数（CDF）近似产生了显式的初始种子公式，其精度通过数值方法得到验证，且在种子阶段无需任何迭代或数值反演。在深度虚值区域，一个高斯尾部长度抵消恒等式——Mills 比——揭示了 Black–Scholes 价格的渐近结构，并启发了一种比率修正的种子，使其在较大实值度情况下达到接近机器精度的初始化。所有分区边界均由 CDF 截断容差和数值（此处摘要原文截断）解析推导得出。
tldr: 本文提出一种分区求解的 Black–Scholes 隐含波动率方法，通过渐近展开推导出完全闭式的解析初始种子，在平值、适度虚值和深度虚值区域均实现无需迭代的高精度快速初始化。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a regime-split Black-Scholes implied volatility solver with fully closed-form analytical initial seeds derived from asymptotic expansions, achieving iteration-free, near-machine-precision initialization across at-the-money, moderate, and deep out-of-the-money regimes.
